code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    frames = []
    frame_cells = set()
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row if v}
    for color in colors:
        cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        r0 = min(r for r, c in cells); r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
        c0 = min(c for r, c in cells); c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
        if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2:
            continue
        perimeter = ([(r0,c) for c in range(c0,c1+1)] + [(r1,c) for c in range(c0,c1+1)] +
                     [(r,c0) for r in range(r0+1,r1)] + [(r,c1) for r in range(r0+1,r1)])
        if all(grid[r][c] == color for r,c in perimeter):
            # An outlined rectangle with an empty interior.
            if all(grid[r][c] == 0 for r in range(r0+1,r1) for c in range(c0+1,c1)):
                frames.append((r0,r1,c0,c1,color))
                frame_cells.update(perimeter)
    if not frames:
        return out
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
                     if grid[r][c] != 0 and (r,c) not in frame_cells)
    # Frequencies of the scattered color markers pair, in order, with frame interior sizes.
    marker_colors = sorted(counts, key=lambda color: (counts[color], color))
    frames.sort(key=lambda f: ((f[1]-f[0]-1)*(f[3]-f[2]-1), f[0], f[2]))
    for frame, fill in zip(frames, marker_colors):
        r0,r1,c0,c1,_ = frame
        for r in range(r0+1,r1):
            for c in range(c0+1,c1):
                if (r-r0-1 + c-c0-1) % 2 == 0:
                    out[r][c] = fill
    return out
'''

def parse_pair_text(text):
 pairs=[]
 lines=text.splitlines()
 for i,line in enumerate(lines):
  m=re.search(r'Demo pair \d+ (input|output) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):',line)
  if not m: continue
  kind,h,w=m.group(1),int(m.group(2)),int(m.group(3))
  grid=[[int(x) for x in lines[i+j+1].split()] for j in range(h)]
  assert all(len(row)==w for row in grid)
  pairs.append((kind,grid))
 return pairs
